verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS that bundles many command-line tools, so whether it supports git history rewriting is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions git, rebase, squashing, or any commit-history editing. The listed tools are vim, Python, Lua, JS, C/C++, TeX and pkg-installed commands like zip and ffmpeg.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can interactively rewrite history by deleting, editing, squashing, or reordering commits
